solverName: Naive Inclusion-Exclusion Backtracking Dominating Set Solver
solverDefinition: Exhaustively enumerates every subset of vertices via a binary include/exclude recursion: at each vertex, branches into one call that includes it in the candidate set D and one that excludes it. No pruning is applied while branching -- the full recursion tree is built out to all n vertices before a candidate is checked. Once a subset is complete, it is accepted if its size is <= K and it dominates every vertex (every vertex is either in D or adjacent to a vertex in D). Returns the first such subset found.
source: Fomin, F. V., & Kratsch, D. (2010). Exact Exponential Algorithms. Springer Science & Business Media.
